_comment: Per routine 15 slots: 0 = warm-up, 1..13 = movements, 14 = finish.
jp: Japanese name for rows 2-3 (<= 16 glyphs, a space = blank glyph);
name: English name for row 1 (<= 29 chars, screen font is upper case);
cue_jp: scroller cue (<= 16 glyphs); cue_en: scroller cue (<= 38 chars).
the cues are short instructions derived from the site's cue/tagline texts.

slots.name: warm-up: get ready
slots.jp: ラジオ体操第一 用意
slots.cue_jp: ラジオ体操、はじめましょう
slots.cue_en: Radio Taiso No.1 - get ready!

slots.name: reaching stretch
slots.cue_jp: 腕を上へ、背伸びをして
slots.cue_en: Reach up tall, rise on your toes

slots.name: arm swings with leg bends
slots.jp: 腕を振って脚を曲げ伸ばす運動
slots.cue_jp: 腕を振って、膝を曲げ伸ばし
slots.cue_en: Swing arms, bend and stretch knees

slots.name: arm circles
slots.cue_jp: 腕を大きく回して
slots.cue_en: Big arm circles, loosen shoulders

slots.name: chest opening
slots.cue_jp: 腕を開いて、胸を反らす
slots.cue_en: Arms open wide, lift the chest

slots.name: side bends
slots.cue_jp: 片腕を上げて、横に曲げる
slots.cue_en: One arm over, bend to the side

slots.name: forward & backward bends
slots.jp: 体を前後に曲げる運動
slots.cue_jp: 前に曲げて、後ろに反らす
slots.cue_en: Bounce forward, then arch back

slots.name: body twists
slots.cue_jp: 腕を振って、体をねじる
slots.cue_en: Twist left and right, arms loose

slots.name: up & down stretch
slots.jp: 腕を上下に伸ばす運動
slots.cue_jp: 腕を上へ、肩へ、リズムよく
slots.cue_en: Punch arms up, back to shoulders

slots.name: diagonal bend & chest opening
slots.jp: 体を斜め下に曲げ、胸を反らす運動
slots.cue_jp: 斜め下に曲げて、胸を開く
slots.cue_en: Bend low to one foot, open wide

slots.name: body circles
slots.cue_jp: 上体で大きく円を描く
slots.cue_en: Circle the upper body around

slots.name: light jumps
slots.cue_jp: 両足で軽く跳ぶ
slots.cue_en: Light jumps, soft landings

slots.name: cool-down swings
slots.jp: 腕を振って脚を曲げ伸ばす運動
slots.cue_jp: 腕を振って、力を抜く
slots.cue_en: Easy swings, let the effort go

slots.name: deep breathing
slots.cue_jp: 深く吸って、ゆっくり吐く
slots.cue_en: Breathe in slowly, breathe all out

slots.name: well done!
slots.cue_jp: お疲れさまでした、また明日
slots.cue_en: Well done - see you tomorrow!
